title: Curvature-Flux Representation of Local Dirac-Node Topology from Non-Hermitian Zeeman Quantum Geometry
summary: Local Dirac-node topology is usually described by a winding number or Berry phase, whereas curvature-flux formulations are commonly associated with global band topology. Here we show that the non-Hermitian Zeeman quantum geometric tensor (QGT) provides a curvature-flux representation of local $π_1$ topology. Unlike the conventional Hermitian QGT, whose metric and Berry curvature are fixed respectively by its real symmetric and imaginary antisymmetric parts, the Zeeman QGT must be decomposed according to symmetry under index exchange.
